## Capabilities

The daemon advertises these strings on `/health`; the phone and watch gate features on `supports("x")`. A capability that is advertised but never gated is dead on the client; one gated but not in `DaemonCapabilities.expected` hides silently when the daemon is old.

| capability | gated at | in `expected` |

| `events` | — (nothing gates it) | no |
